privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At open-cvbaba, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our service. Please read this privacy policy carefully.

personal_info.title: Personal Information
personal_info.text: When you create an account, we collect:

document_content.text: We store the content you create and upload to provide our service. This includes CVs, cover letters, and other documents you generate or upload. This content is encrypted and only accessible to you.

usage_info.text: We automatically collect certain information when you use open-cvbaba:

2.text: We use the information we collect to:
items: Provide, maintain, and improve our services
Process your transactions and manage your account
Send you technical notices, updates, and support messages
Respond to your comments, questions, and customer service requests
Analyze usage patterns to improve user experience
Detect, prevent, and address technical issues and security threats

no_sell.text: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties.

service_providers.text: We may share your information with trusted third-party service providers who assist us in:

4.text: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information:

deletion.title: Data Deletion
deletion.text: You can request deletion of your account and associated data at any time. We will delete your information within 30 days, except where we are required to retain it by law.

6.text: We retain your information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you services. We will delete your information within 30 days of account deletion, except where we must retain it to comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, or enforce our agreements.

7.text: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your country of residence. We ensure that such transfers comply with applicable data protection laws and that your information receives adequate protection.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how open-cvbaba ("we", "us", and "our") uses cookies and similar technologies to recognize you when you visit our website. It explains what these technologies are and why we use them, as well as your rights to control our use of them.

summary.title: Essential Cookies
summary.description: Required for the site to function optimally and securely.

summary.title: Your Preferences
summary.description: Remember your settings like language and login state.

summary.title: Analytics
summary.description: Help us understand how you use our site to improve it.

1.title: 1. What are cookies?
1.text_1: Cookies are small data files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. Cookies are widely used by website owners in order to make their websites work, or to work more efficiently, as well as to provide reporting information.
1.text_2: Cookies set by the website owner (in this case, open-cvbaba) are called "first-party cookies". Cookies set by parties other than the website owner are called "third-party cookies". Third-party cookies enable third-party features or functionality to be provided on or through the website (e.g., advertising, interactive content, and analytics).

2.title: 2. Why do we use cookies?
2.text: We use first-party and third-party cookies for several reasons. Some cookies are required for technical reasons in order for our Website to operate, and we refer to these as "essential" or "strictly necessary" cookies. Other cookies also enable us to track and target the interests of our users to enhance the experience on our Online Properties.

types.title: Essential Cookies
types.description: These cookies are strictly necessary to provide you with services available through our website and to use some of its features, such as access to secure areas.

types.title: Performance & Functionality Cookies
types.description: These cookies are used to enhance the performance and functionality of our website but are non-essential to their use. However, without these cookies, certain functionality (like videos) may become unavailable.

types.title: Analytics & Customization Cookies
types.description: These cookies collect information that is used either in aggregate form to help us understand how our website is being used or how effective our marketing campaigns are, or to help us customize our website for you.

3.title: 3. How can I control cookies?
3.text_1: You have the right to decide whether to accept or reject cookies. You can exercise your cookie rights by setting your preferences in the Cookie Consent Manager. The Cookie Consent Manager allows you to select which categories of cookies you accept or reject. Essential cookies cannot be rejected as they are strictly necessary to provide you with services.
3.text_2: The Cookie Consent Manager can be found in the notification banner and on our website. If you choose to reject cookies, you may still use our website though your access to some functionality and areas of our website may be restricted.

browser_controls.title: Browser Controls
browser_controls.text: Most web browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings preferences. To find out more about cookies, including how to see what cookies have been set and how to manage and delete them, visit <1>www.aboutcookies.org</1> or <2>www.allaboutcookies.org</2>.

4.title: 4. Other tracking technologies
4.text: Cookies are not the only way to recognize or track visitors to a website. We may use other, similar technologies from time to time, like web beacons (sometimes called "tracking pixels" or "clear gifs"). These are tiny graphics files that contain a unique identifier that enable us to recognize when someone has visited our website or opened an email including them. This allows us, for example, to monitor the traffic patterns of users from one page within a website to another, to deliver or communicate with cookies, to understand whether you have come to the website from an online advertisement displayed on a third-party website, to improve site performance, and to measure the success of e-mail marketing campaigns. In many instances, these technologies are reliant on cookies to function properly, and so declining cookies will impair their functioning.

5.title: 5. Updates to this policy
5.text_1: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time in order to reflect, for example, changes to the cookies we use or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. Please therefore re-visit this Cookie Policy regularly to stay informed about our use of cookies and related technologies.
5.text_2: The date at the top of this Cookie Policy indicates when it was last updated.

6.title: 6. Contact Us
6.text: If you have any questions about our use of cookies or other technologies, please email us at:

faq_page.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq_page.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about open-cvbaba. Can't find what you're looking for?
faq_page.no_results: No questions found. Try a different search or category.

items.question: How many credits does each document cost?
items.answer: Every document costs 3 credits, including CVs, cover letters, SOPs, reports, recommendation letters, and essays. This consistent pricing makes it easy to plan your usage.

items.question: Which plan should I choose?
items.answer: Choose Credit Packs if you create 1 to 3 documents per month. Choose VIP if you create documents more regularly and want to save up to 60% per document with monthly credits.

items.question: Do credits expire?
items.answer: Credits are valid for 1 year from the date of purchase. For VIP plans, monthly credits roll over to your next billing cycle automatically, so you never lose what you have paid for within the year.

items.question: Can I change plans anytime?
items.answer: Yes, absolutely! You can upgrade or downgrade anytime. Unused credits roll over to your next billing cycle, so you never lose value.

items.question: What if I run out of credits?
items.answer: You can buy more credit packs anytime, or upgrade to a VIP monthly plan for better rates and automatic monthly credits.

items.question: Is there a free trial?
items.answer: Yes! Every new user gets 1 free document (5 free credits) to try open-cvbaba before making any payment. No credit card required to start.

items.question: Can I get a team or enterprise discount?
items.answer: Yes. We offer custom volume pricing for teams, universities, and agencies. Contact us at pricing@open-cvbaba.com for a quote.

items.question: Do you offer refunds?
items.answer: Credit pack purchases are non refundable since credits remain valid for a full year. VIP subscriptions can be cancelled anytime, and your remaining credits roll into the next month until used within their 1 year validity period.

items.question: How do I create my first document?
items.answer: Simply sign up for a free account, describe what you want in plain language (like "create a CV for a software engineer position"), and open-cvbaba will generate a professionally formatted document in seconds.

items.question: Do I need design skills to use open-cvbaba?
items.answer: Not at all! open-cvbaba automatically handles all formatting, layout, and design. You just provide the content in your own words, and we make it look professional.

items.question: What types of documents can I create?
items.answer: You can create CVs/resumes, cover letters, statements of purpose (SOPs), personal statements, recommendation letters, business reports, and proposals.

items.question: Can I upload my existing CV or resume?
items.answer: Yes! You can upload your existing document, and open-cvbaba will help you update, improve, or reformat it. You can also translate it or tailor it for specific jobs.

items.question: Can I customize the templates?
items.answer: Yes! Choose from 35+ professional templates, and customize colors, fonts, and layouts. You can also switch templates anytime without losing your content.

items.question: What file formats can I export?
items.answer: You can export your documents as PDF (recommended for applications) or Word (.docx) for further editing. Both formats maintain professional formatting.

items.question: Can I translate my documents?
items.answer: Yes! open-cvbaba supports translation to 50+ languages while maintaining professional formatting. Perfect for international job applications.

items.question: How does the AI optimization work?
items.answer: Our AI analyzes job descriptions and suggests improvements to your CV or cover letter, helping you highlight relevant skills and experience that match the position.

items.question: Can I save multiple versions of my documents?
items.answer: Yes! Save unlimited versions and variations. This is perfect for tailoring your CV or cover letter for different job applications.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Absolutely. We use industry-standard encryption to protect your data. Your documents are private and never shared with third parties. You can delete your data anytime.

items.question: Can I delete my account?
items.answer: Yes, you can delete your account anytime from your settings. This will permanently remove all your data from our servers.

items.question: How do I reset my password?
items.answer: Click "Forgot Password" on the login page, enter your email, and we'll send you a secure link to reset your password.

items.question: How can I get help if I'm stuck?
items.answer: You can contact our support team via the contact form, email us at support@open-cvbaba.com, or check our help center for guides and tutorials.

items.question: What are your support hours?
items.answer: Our support team is available 24/7. We are always here to help you, no matter the time or time zone.

items.question: Do you offer live chat support?
items.answer: Currently, we offer email support with fast response times. Live chat is coming soon for VIP subscribers.

sop.prompt: Write a statement of purpose for a Master's in Data Science at MIT
sop.title: Statement of Purpose
paragraphs: My journey into data science began during my undergraduate research, where I discovered the transformative power of machine learning in solving complex real-world problems. This passion has driven me to pursue a Master's degree at MIT, where I aim to push the boundaries of AI research.

During my time at Stanford, I led a research project analyzing climate data patterns, resulting in a publication at NeurIPS. This experience taught me the importance of rigorous methodology and creative problem-solving.

At MIT, I am particularly drawn to Professor Johnson's work on interpretable ML systems. I believe my background in both software engineering and research positions me uniquely to contribute to this cutting-edge field.
sop.closing: I am confident that MIT's collaborative environment and world-class faculty will provide the ideal platform for me to achieve my research goals and make meaningful contributions to the field of data science.

cover_letter.prompt: Write a cover letter for a Product Manager position at Google
paragraphs: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Product Manager position at Google. With three years of experience building and scaling products at fast-paced startups, I am excited about the opportunity to drive innovation at a company that shapes how billions of people interact with technology.

At TechFlow, I led the development of a microservices platform that now serves over 2 million daily active users. I collaborated closely with engineering, design, and data science teams to define product strategy, prioritize features, and deliver measurable improvements to user engagement.

I am particularly drawn to Google's commitment to building products that are accessible and beneficial to everyone. I would love the opportunity to bring my technical background and user-centric approach to your team.
cover_letter.closing: Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Google's mission.
